- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by the user’s Pokémon/cowboy game concept. The user clarified that the supplied image is the box art.

- Build and run the game without asking questions.
- Honor the box art’s two dog characters and their cowboy theme.

## Decisions
- Reframed the game around the box-art names: “Rootin’ Tootin’ Bootin’” and “What the Hell, Chewy?” as Black/White versions.
- Made Bootin’ and Chewy switchable playable legendary pups; gameplay involves collecting six treats and returning to the ranch.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a self-contained browser game shell in `index.html` and gameplay implementation in `game.js`.
- Added movement, treat collection, obstacles, edition/pup switching, ranch finish condition, mobile touch controls, and restart handling.
- Updated the setting with a western landscape and drew custom cowboy-dog sprites.

### Active
- Finish the box-art-inspired implementation and verify the game renders and plays correctly.
- Check `game.js` for remaining references or logic inconsistent with the dog/treat concept.

3. Report the game’s controls and any assumptions in the completion summary.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, title/HUD, mission text, and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas-rendered western world, controls, dog characters, collection and victory logic.
- `start.sh`: Project runtime launcher.

## Important Context
- The user clarified: “That is the box art.” The supplied artwork depicts two cowboy-boot-wearing dogs with the captions “Rootin Tootin Bootin” (Black Version) and “what the hell Chewy” (White Version).

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by the box art, featuring its two cowboy-dog characters.

## Requirements
- Build and run the game without asking questions.
- Honor the box art’s two dog characters and cowboy theme.

## Decisions
- Use the box-art names and editions: “Rootin’ Tootin’ Bootin’” (Black Version) and “What the Hell, Chewy?” (White Version).
- Make Bootin’ and Chewy switchable playable pups; collect six golden treats and return to the ranch campfire.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, western world, cowboy-dog sprites, movement, obstacles, treat collection, pup switching, campfire victory, restart, and touch controls.
- Refined mobile layout to preserve the canvas aspect ratio, compact HUD and mission text, and keep landscape touch controls beside the play area.
- Verified gameplay collection, victory, pup switching, and restart in Chromium; `node --check game.js` passes and the local server returns HTTP 200.

### Active
- Final check of mobile touch controls and portrait rendering after the responsive layout changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Verify mobile touch controls in portrait and landscape, then rerun the final checks.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, responsive layout, HUD, and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Gameplay, rendering, controls, and game state.
- `start.sh`: Runtime launcher.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are currently untracked.
- Portrait and landscape Chromium screenshots were reviewed; the latest landscape layout places controls in a dedicated side panel.
